tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List public product metadata, including a free Binance SOLUSDT 30-row partial trade sample. No API key or wallet is needed; paid content is not returned.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search product IDs, titles, and human-written summaries, including the free Binance SOLUSDT trade sample (30 rows, not a complete minute). No API key or wallet; paid content is not returned.

tools.name: preview_product
tools.description: Read one product's public metadata, summary, version hash, price, and license without an API key or wallet. The free Binance SOLUSDT 30-row sample is partial, not a complete minute; its upstream redistribution rights are unconfirmed.

tools.name: read_free_product
tools.description: Read one free product in the current public snapshot without an API key or wallet. Includes a Binance SOLUSDT 30-row partial trade sample, not a complete minute or real-time data; market type, quantity units, and upstream redistribution rights are unverified. Check preview_product and pin expected_h

tools.name: read_paid_product
tools.description: Pay exactly 0.01 USDT0 on the configured Tempo network, then read one paid product.
